notes.subject: מטוב
notes.rationale: 'Silent even from good' (refrained even from good words) vs 'silent from good' as lacking comfort (JPS 'had no comfort' reads differently).

notes.subject: נעכר
notes.rationale: 'Stirred/roiled' (KJV, fire image of v4) vs 'held in check' (JPS); root means to roil water.

notes.subject: דומיה
notes.rationale: Silence-stillness noun used adverbially; rendered 'nin bɛɛ la' (in all quietness).

translation: N ma kuma, nin bɛɛ la; n ye dɔgɔkun kɛ, hali ka bɔ nyumannu kɔrɔdɔ la; n toɔ ka gɛlɛya ka bɔ.
